pull_request.title: Calorimeter: prototype physical ECAL and HCAL cassettes
pull_request.head: codex/calorimeter-cassettes
pull_request.body:
ODD's sampling layers lack physical cassette containment, readout packaging and a traceable continuous-operation service budget. This first hardware PR adds isolated Si–W ECAL and steel/scintillator HCAL cassette prototypes, following the technology baseline confirmed by Andreas and the programme in #66.

The ECAL unit has four silicon sensors / 1,024 cells; the HCAL has 144 wrapped SiPM tiles. Both include boards, explicit readout packages, frames/covers, thermal pads/posts, a copper spreader and titanium/water pipes. Absorber patches belong to the sector and must be replaced by continuous sector plates in repeated assemblies.

DES028 distinguishes CALICE hardware facts from proposed nODD dimensions and operating hypotheses. Cassette bodies are 8.0 / 10.275 mm deep and weigh 0.649 / 3.319 kg, excluding absorber. Continuous heat budgets are 3.93 / 3.04 W; HCAL electronics power, packaging, cooling and electrical assumptions need expert review. The thicker ECAL changes the required envelope; the HCAL removes ODD's unexplained 16 mm PCB proxy.

Validation: seven physical/conservation/negative controls; native DD4hep1.38/ROOT6.40.04 construction, 859 material parts, 148 unique sensitive IDs, all 1,168 cells checked, independent mass/constituent agreement, zero overlaps at10 nm and ten material rays. Two seeded Geant4 11.4.2 muon events saved valid positive-energy calorimeter hits. Source/config/library hashes, figures and reproducible commands are committed. Project records, paired journal and token-site checks pass; exact current token counters remain unavailable.

DRAFT prototype: production geometry is not integrated and no engineering/performance sign-off is inferred. Next dependent PR builds sectors and complete barrel/endcap assemblies from these components. Existing dependencies only; no external software introduced.
